Ten Kilos to One

STS-HS10-L3-13001400-HSSCILIFE-STP-MNA-02 • HS Life Science Grades 9-10 • Cycling of Matter and Flow of Energy in Ecosystems
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Every spring the Arid Lands Food Lab runs Desert Tank, a night when student teams pitch a food idea to a panel of judges. Yasmin and Karim are pitching a small fish and plant farm that recycles the same tank of water in a place where rain almost never falls. Their whole case rests on one number, because only about ten percent of the energy at one level moves up to the next, so feeding people from lower on the pyramid stretches every drop and every kilogram further.
If you had to feed a desert town with one plant and one animal, which two would you choose, and what would you give up?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Yasmin doing?
Look at the picture. Explain what Yasmin is doing and what she wants people to notice. Speak in two complete sentences and name the exact level her finger reaches.
2
What is Karim holding?
Look at the picture. Explain what Karim is holding and why it belongs in this room. Speak in two complete sentences and name the container and its contents exactly.
3

Look at the picture. Explain what the teacher is doing and what it helps people understand. Speak in two complete sentences and use exact words for the tool and the object on it.
4
What kind of place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Explain what kind of place this is and how you know. Speak in two complete sentences and name two exact features, not general words like stuff.
5
Tell me about the board.
Look at the picture. Explain what the board shows and how its parts fit together. Speak in two complete sentences and use the exact labels and numbers printed on it.
6
Tell me about what Layla is wearing.
Look at the picture. Explain what Layla is wearing and what it tells you about her role. Speak in two complete sentences and name each item of clothing exactly.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: NGSS HS-LS2-4 — Use mathematical representations to support claims for the cycling of matter and flow of energy among organisms in an ecosystem. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
